title: Relentless Rhythm
description: 3-round HIIT with squat jumps, broad jumps, star jumps, high knees and skaters for explosive cardio

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Fast marching in place
exercises.instructions: Walk briskly in place swinging your arms

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with maximum jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs in a star shape

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, knees above hips, arms coordinated

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
